newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Mixed plantings outlook.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Mixed plantings outlook.

text.p: Delays to plantings remained the main focus of the spring wheat market Thursday with producer sales remaining slow, dealers said.
In western spring wheat states such as Idaho and Montana the outlook appeared to be improving slightly with warmer temperatures and drying winds forecast for the weekend.
One Montana dealer said it was possible farmers would be in the fields in his state early next week.
"The fields here dry out in a heck of a hurry," he said.
Spring wheat in Montana is normally planted between April 10 and May 20, cash grain dealers in the state said.
Further east in Minnesota, however, it appeared unlikely there would be much planting before the end of the month.
Export demand for both spring and white wheat remained reasonable with the Japanese Food Agency buying 20,000 tonnes of each at its weekly tender.
